$comment: Application Insights Java 3.x agent configuration (WS-C / M4).
Attached to the JVM at deploy time via -javaagent (see README.md); it is NOT a code
dependency. The connection string is supplied out-of-band via the
APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING env var, sourced from Key Vault at provisioning (WS-D).
If that env var is absent the agent stays inert and the app boots identically - which is
exactly what lets this land before the live App Insights resource exists.
